description: An eclectic group of friends from different high schools and one National University student, united for the love of science, because life gets richer when different poins of views and personalities works togheter.
summary: Our health monitor differs from others: aside from taking into consideration modern advancements, its better than other dashboards, it is optimized to be as user friendly as possible, helps everyone to interact and understand it plus help in case of dire situations. Without relying on a single person, making collaboration between astronauts even more common than usual. It tracks habits, rewards consistency and calculates a bunch of factors together.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

Three separate dashboards with their own priorities, data and contexts

What benefits does it have?

Makes the user understand their health from a glance, being able to get more details from just a tap and advanced info inmediately. It takes into consideration ease of use and little to no obstruction during use.

What is the intended impact of the project?

Being able to be a apply once, work for a lot type project: it has language support with english, makes it possible for astronauts to receive help from medics on earth and could help in space explorations.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use to develop your project?

We made the site using the true and tried CSS, JS and HTML stack, with information loaded with JSON and JEV as AI for results.

How is your project creative?

Instead of trying to reinvent the wheel by making/modifying a smartwatch, we take advantage of projects that already made progress in those regards to advance.

What factors did your team consider?

We spent a lot of time deliberating about the intended use: should the program be single-person tailored or available to everyone? Should it be less or more detailed than usual? What colors, symbols, languages and UX do we use to make it emmergency ready? All of these were carefully thought upon.
